prompt.project_info: Create a raw photorealistic quiet bedroom lifestyle portrait with soft morning window light, preserving the charcoal lace texture, knitted rug and introspective mood.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long naturally messy light-brown hair, fair skin with warm undertones, realistic pores and a downward pensive gaze. She wears a charcoal lace camisole-style top and matching lace bottoms with floral embroidery, presented as a fashion/editorial wardrobe reference with non-explicit coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 slightly high-angle smartphone frame with a gentle tilt and full seated figure. The adult woman sits on a cream knitted rug in a relaxed wide-leg pose, leaning slightly forward and looking down. Include white and olive-green walls, wooden bed frame, white bedding, light-wood TV stand and soft bedroom furniture in slight background blur.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused daylight from a window creates soft highlights on hair, lace and realistic skin with gentle shadows. Keep the atmosphere private, calm, solitary, homey and non-explicit.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone snapshot, slightly high angle, shallow background blur, realistic mobile grain, sharp lace and rug weave, natural proportions, soft morning color and unposed documentary feel.
